title: The First Man Clothed in the Elements: Swallowed Light Becomes the River of Judgment
description: In the first appointed time the First Man clothed himself with the elements and stood fast against the Darkness, offering his living garment to be swallowed by the archons. That swallowed light, lodged inside them, becomes a hidden river of judgment that burns them from within, binds them in their own dryness, and will at the consummation release the whole cosmos of flesh — the visible judgment on earth being only the smallest branch of that vast hidden work, and the warrior in silver garments revealed as the great God himself.
